definitions.phantom_front_episodes: WALL episodes whose median (value - true strip) < -0.5 m, an empty strip counting as -inf; kind empty/short
definitions.end_wall_error: moving-window cycles with a true strip range < 3.0 m: value - strip over the WALL ones (|err| p95 / max); the rest are miss_cycles
definitions.all_wall_error: every WALL cycle with a finite strip (the pre-v2 "end-wall error"): signed p05/p95, max |err|
definitions.no_data_pct: NO_DATA share of contract time (holds capped at 0.5 s), all and moving window
definitions.tracks_rho_lt_0_5: distinct CONFIRMED track ids with |rho_bl| < 0.5 m; recorded and replay published tracks are like-for-like, _all_live is not

recorded.source: /perception/virtual_wall/debug on the car's tracker steps; tracks from /perception/walls (published <= 4)

replay_rec.source: replay pass "rec" (recorded stereo inputs); tracks_rho_lt_0_5 from its own /perception/walls (like-for-like with recorded), _all_live from every live track of its payload
